scope: All 1,994 pinned full descriptions/native fields and composed recipes checked programmatically in both editions. This pass individually read 87 complete suspect descriptions; 69 directed or semantic corrections. Actual served-file, alpha lifetime and audio decode checks are separate parent-led evidence. No claim all spells watched in Foundry.
methodology: Meaningful composition ignores labels, IDs, sound, raw millisecond changes and small rank-scale changes; preserves media, sequence roles, direction, repetitions, target selection, motion, entrance/exit direction, filters and quantized active tracks. Family metric also ignores exact media/color variants. Geometry and edition key availability do not prove every served file exists or every frame looks correct.
